Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated the ship was “launched 1930” as München, conflating the 1930 renaming with the actual 1923 launch. This factual error could misidentify the vessel; the ship was launched in 1923 and renamed General von Steuben in 1930 after Baron von Steuben (who served in the Continental Army).
